meta.title: Language & Intercultural Business Support | JANUS
meta.description: JANUS coordinates interpreting, translation, meeting preparation and intercultural support for companies running international projects.

hero.h1: One point of contact for your international projects.
hero.sousTexte: JANUS coordinates the language and intercultural side of your projects: interpreting, translation, meeting preparation, on-site support, and coaching for executives and teams.

message.texte: JANUS keeps the context of your project in mind and coordinates the language and intercultural expertise you need, from one meeting to the next.
message.perimetre: JANUS works alongside your teams and advisers, without replacing legal, financial or industry expertise.

etapes.texte: Understand the context, prepare the meetings and the people involved.
Remotely or on site, in France and abroad.
One point of contact coordinates the expertise needed throughout the project.

mobilite.texte: Language and intercultural preparation before an assignment abroad, and support for international employees joining teams in France.

pologne.texte: In-depth knowledge of the languages, business codes and on-the-ground realities on both sides.

principale.texte: Language and intercultural support during a France–Poland M&A transaction.

secondaire.texte: On-site support for a Germany–Poland industrial assignment.

preuves.parcours: JANUS was founded in Lyon in 2021 by Agata Mich, following an international career in Paris and Geneva. Agata Mich works in French, Polish and English.

pourQui.directions: Executive management, procurement, sales and international teams

ctaFinal.h2: An international project in the pipeline?
ctaFinal.texte: Tell us about the context, the countries and the languages involved.
